notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.notes:
- Fixed all known errors. Also, work was done to optimize resources and improve the code.

- For the slot machines in the Hotel, 3 games have been added. For victory in each of them a unique permanent bonus is given.

- The reload mechanics have been reworked. Now you can do it faster by pressing the reload button "R".

- Added 3 new time bonuses using new game mechanics.

- Improved boss fight balance for different difficulty levels.

And also some other nice little things that improve the gaming experience. Stay tuned, this update is far from the last.

Have a good game!
